description: Features common neopet-isms like a restocking market, pet care, item collection/trading, a battle system, and overall customization of pet pages.
Features a player-submitted artwork system for custom items, apparel, etc.
Player interface has a state-of-the-art feel to it.
Clicking another player's eggs/pets as a central mechanic.
Breeding offspring as a central mechanic.
Doesn't make up for its age through appropriate technologies or does it rather badly.
Features meaningful customization features such as pet pages, interesting BBCode flavors, or other ways to express yourself.
